test_adapter.transport: persistent stdin/stdout JSONL; one correlated response per request; no expected is sent

request.arguments: fixture request + authority; no case id

test_adapter.response: {request_id, binding, result, artifacts, error}; keys absent remain absent, never inferred success
test_adapter.fault_barrier: Test adapter emits {test_barrier:name,binding}; collector records real Engine state then kills entire adapter process group; restart same external state_dir. execute receives test barrier only in trusted test context, never task env.

discovery_policy: all cases and Cartesian parameter combinations required; no silent skip, dependency absence nonzero MISSING_DEPENDENCY; no actual target nonzero MISSING_COMPONENT
negative_policy: same observer must reject known_bad_variant for each family before G4 acceptance; missing artifacts/field/case/ref are failures
